name: shoes
description: Shoes and boots, new or used.

size.description: The size, as on the label or in the seller's words.

ships.description: True when the seller ships the item. False or absent: handed over in person.

howDealsGo: In person, the buyer looks it over, pays and releases in one tap. Shipped, the buyer pays into escrow first and releases when it arrives as described; the seller records the delivery in their folder, and a timer to the seller, set past the expected arrival, pays if the buyer goes quiet. Before paying, ask for photos of the soles and of the size on the label.
